name: X-Man Tornado V3 M Pioneer 3x3 (Revived Limited Edition)
description: Experience true innovation and collector’s prestige with the X-Man Tornado V3 M Pioneer 3x3 (Revived Limited Edition) —a celebration of both elite performance and exclusive craftsmanship. Building on the legendary reputation of the Tornado V3 M Pioneer, this limited release fuses ultra-modern design with world-class speedcubing engineering, making it a must-have for competitive cubers and collectors alike.
features: Advanced Magnetic System: Enjoy the cutting-edge feel of both corner and core magnets for ultra-stable, controllable turning—no matter your turning style.
